_doc: Things waiting for the user to watch, listen to or decide. The dashboard shows them first, with players. Agents: add an item whenever you need the user's eyes or ears; never ask them to open files in GitHub or chat. Remove (or set status: done) once decided, and record the decision in docs/DECISIONS.md. kind: audio | video | image. files: repo paths.

items.title: Point Roberts v2 — the rebuild you asked for (richer than the Emu War)
items.question: You said both earlier versions were terrible: irrelevant scenes, empty frames, a flag or an orange circle for a hook. This is rebuilt from scratch: a drawn world in every beat (the town and its one road, an 1846 desk, surveyors cutting the peninsula loose, a school bus crossing four times, a pipe under the border, a crowd of shoppers), the whole canvas used, and the real OpenStreetMap coastline instead of the three-point blob. It runs 60 s. It also beats the quality bar the motion kit set: 0.40 s of near-still screen per 30 s against a 1 s limit; the Emu War is 1.44 s. Watch it and tell me what still falls short. The old versions are underneath for comparison. Narration is the free Kokoro voice (bm_george) while the OpenRouter key is rotated.

items.title: Action: replace the OpenRouter key (the old one was exposed)
items.question: The key was pasted into the vault file as plain text in a public repo (commit 18a5b52), so treat it as public. 1) openrouter.ai → Keys → delete that key, create a new one. 2) On your laptop: $env:STUDIO_VAULT_KEY = "<vault key>"; "<new key>" | python studio\tools\vault.py set OPENROUTER_API_KEY  3) Upload studio\vault.enc.json to GitHub (studio folder). Never paste a key directly into the file.
